newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FTC requests more information from Cardinal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FTC requests more information from Cardinal.

text.p: Cardinal Health Inc and Owen Healthcare Inc said Monday they received a request for additional information from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission regarding their proposed merger.
This request extends the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 during which the FTC is permitted to review the proposed deal.
The companies said the request was not unexpected, and they intend to comply with the FTC's request for information expeditiously.
The companies said they expect to complete the deal during the first quarter, subject to approval by Owen shareholders and other customary conditions.
In November, healthcare provider Cardinal Health said it would acquire hospital pharmacy service provider Owen Healthcare in a deal valued at $496 million.
